name: Blight Stones
description: Consumes a target tree to heal 100 Health over 16 seconds. Contains 3 charges.
flavor: A favorite tool of the daemons, Blight Stones drain the life out of ancient trees to restore the health of those who invoke them.
upgrade: Basic consumable starting item.

name: Ward of Sight
description: Places an invisible ward that grants vision of the surrounding area for 6 minutes.
flavor: Only one quarry in all the lands of Newerth yields up the stone that can be used to make Wards of Sight.

name: Golden Apple
description: Consumable fruit that restores 150 Health and 100 Mana instantly.
flavor: Enchanted fruit plucked from the celestial gardens of Sol, providing immediate rejuvenation in combat.

name: Orb of Zamos
description: Grants +2 to all attributes and increases spell damage.
flavor: A shimmering orb containing compressed cosmic essence that enhances a hero's core attributes and magical potency.

name: Mana Potion
description: Restores 100 Mana over 20 seconds. Interrupted if damaged by enemy heroes.
flavor: Distilled arcane elixir that replenishes spent magical reserves for frontline spellcasters.

name: Grave Locket
description: Grants +3 All Stats, +2 Armor, +6 Damage, and gains charges on nearby enemy hero deaths to boost attributes.
flavor: A sinister locket that traps departing souls to empower its owner on the battlefield.

name: Plated Greaves
description: Grants +55 Movement Speed and +5 Armor. Activate to grant nearby allies +2 Armor.
flavor: Heavy iron greaves designed for vanguard champions, providing movement speed and armor aura.

name: Blood Chalice
description: Sacrifices 150 Health to instantly grant 100 Mana. Restores health on hero kills.
flavor: A ritual vessel that trades physical blood for instant magical energy during high-stakes engagements.

name: Sacrificial Stone
description: Grants +250 Health, +250 Mana, and increases health and mana regeneration.
flavor: An ancient monument carved by dark cultists, channeling sacrificed souls into lasting endurance.

name: Astrolabe
description: Activate to heal all nearby allied units for 250 Health and grant +2 Armor.
flavor: A celestial navigation instrument that harnesses starlight to mend wounds across allied ranks.

name: Tablet of Command
description: Pushes target unit 500 units in the direction it is facing. Interrupts channeling.
flavor: Engraved with ancient command runes, this tablet forcefully propels friend or foe alike across the battlefield.
upgrade: Core mobility component for casters and initiators.

name: Sand Scepter
description: Activate to lift target hero into an invulnerable cyclone for 2.5 seconds.
flavor: Imbued with desert whirlwinds, this scepter traps champions in suspended elemental isolation.
upgrade: Provides crowd control and self-invulnerability.

name: Dreamcatcher
description: Grants intelligence, mana regeneration, and reduces enemy magic resistance on hit.
flavor: A mystical talisman that weaves nightmare magic into spell attacks.

name: Kuldra's Sheepstick
description: Activate to hex target enemy unit into a harmless critter for 3.5 seconds, silencing, disarming, and slowing them.
flavor: Crafted by the master illusionist Kuldra, this ancient staff transmutes even the fiercest champion into a helpless creature.
upgrade: Ultimate disarm & silence hex artifact.

name: Master's Legacy
description: Grants stats and enhances hero ultimate capabilities.
flavor: The legendary crest handed down through generations of archmages to awaken ultimate power.
upgrade: Enhances hero ultimate abilities.

name: Grimoire of Power
description: Grants +25 Intelligence, +15% Spell Amplification, and causes spell damage to apply a burning damage over time effect.
flavor: Bound in dragon hide and inked with arcane runes of forbidden knowledge, the Grimoire amplifies magical destructive force to legendary heights.
upgrade: Can be combined with Lightbrand and Frostbrand into Dawnbringer.

name: Lex Talionis
description: Activate to target an enemy hero, reducing their armor by 6 while reducing your own armor by 6 for 7 seconds.
flavor: An eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth.

name: Barrier Idol
description: Activate to grant nearby allies a magic barrier absorbing up to 400 Magic Damage.
flavor: A protective totem blessed by Beast shamans to shield armies from catastrophic spellfire.

name: Arcane Bomb
description: Activate to detonate an energy pulse dealing magic damage and burning enemy mana.
flavor: A volatile explosive packed with unstable mana crystals that vaporize enemy spell reserves.

name: Nome's Wisdom
description: Grants intelligence and armor. Casting spells heals nearby allies for a portion of mana spent.
flavor: The sacred tome of High Priest Nome, converting spent mana into healing surges for surrounding companions.

name: Abyssal Skull
description: Grants lifesteal aura, bonus damage, and armor aura to nearby friendly melee and ranged units.
flavor: The skull of an abyssal demon that radiates a vampiric aura over allied forces.

name: Daemonic Breastplate
description: Grants +10 Armor, +55 Attack Speed, and an aura that boosts ally armor and attack speed while reducing enemy armor.
flavor: Forged in hellfire, this plate armor inspires bloodlust in allies while weakening enemy defenses.
upgrade: Grants high armor and aura reducing enemy armor.

name: Portal Key
description: Activate to instantly teleport up to 1200 units away. Goes on a 3-second cooldown if damaged by enemy heroes.
flavor: Portal Keys tear asunder the tenuous barriers between dimensions, enabling instant teleportation across short distances.
upgrade: Core mobility item for all roles.

name: Shrunken Head
description: Activate to gain Spell Immunity and +100% Magic Resistance for up to 10 seconds.
flavor: A grisly talisman preserved by ancient witch doctors. Channeling its dark magic surrounds the bearer in an impenetrable barrier against hostile spells.
upgrade: Essential spell immunity artifact.

name: Hellflower
description: Activate to silence, perplex, and increase damage dealt against target enemy hero for 5 seconds.
flavor: Harvested in lands untouched by Newerth's sun, Hellflowers stink of death and are covered in burning thorns. The aroma induces a battle-frenzy while silencing enemy spells.
upgrade: Core silence artifact for spellcasters (3x Great Arcana).

name: Null Stone
description: Passively blocks a targeted enemy spell once every 13 seconds.
flavor: A mysterious gemstone that nullifies targeted hostile sorcery before it takes effect.
upgrade: Passively blocks single-target enemy spells.

name: Sustainer
description: Grants +6 Health Regen and +150% Mana Regen.
flavor: A twin-vial ornament that steadily restores health and magical energy.
upgrade: Builds into Null Stone, Restoration Stone, or Runed Cleaver.

name: Steamboots
description: Grants +60 Movement Speed, +10 Selected Attribute, and +25 Attack Speed. Activate to toggle selected attribute.
flavor: Powered by pressurized steam pistons, these boots allow warriors to adapt physical and magical attributes.
upgrade: Core attribute toggling boots.

name: Striders
description: Grants +100 Movement Speed when out of combat. Speed drops to +50 when attacking or damaged.
flavor: Lightweight boots crafted for rapid scouting across the vast wilderness of Newerth.

name: Power Supply
description: Gains charges when nearby enemy heroes cast spells (max 15). Activate to restore 15 Health and 15 Mana per charge.
flavor: A battery that absorbs stray magical energy released by enemy spells to convert into emergency healing.

name: Logger's Hatchet
description: Grants +12% bonus damage to creeps for melee heroes (+6% for ranged heroes).
flavor: A sturdy woodsman axe prized by laners for clearing trees and securing last hits.

name: Spellshards
description: Grants +21 Intelligence, +7% Movement Speed, -15% Cooldowns, and ignores 30% of enemy Magic Armor on Level 1.
flavor: Crystalline shards that pierce magical barriers to inflict devastating spell damage.
upgrade: Upgradable up to Level 3 for +1,000 Gold per recipe scroll (+15% magic armor pierce per tier).

name: Harkon's Blade
description: Grants +35 Intelligence, +20 Damage, +15% Attack Speed, +125% Mana Regeneration. Basic attacks deal Magic Damage instead of Physical Damage and reduce target Magic Armor by 5 for 5 seconds.
flavor: Forged by the dark archmage Harkon, turning physical sword blows into pure magic devastation.
upgrade: Basic attacks deal magic damage and shred enemy magic armor.

name: Restoration Stone
description: Activate to instantly reset all ability and item cooldowns.
flavor: A relic of chronomancy that rewinds time for the bearer's spells and artifacts.
upgrade: Ultimate cooldown reset artifact.

name: Void Talisman
description: Activate to become immune to physical attacks for 4 seconds, taking +40% magic damage.
flavor: Shifts the bearer into a void plane, escaping physical weapons at the cost of vulnerability to spells.
upgrade: Provides physical immunity in emergency situations.

name: Veiled Rot
description: Consumable ward emitting invisible rot aura to nearby enemies, dealing magic damage over time.
flavor: A pungent vial of decaying swamp essence.

name: Jade Spire
description: Grants +20 Intelligence, +250 Mana, +1.5 Mana Regen, and increases spell cast range by 200 units.
flavor: Carved from pure enchanted jade deep within the Obsidian Peaks, the Jade Spire focuses mystical energies to extend a spellcaster's reach beyond ordinary magical bounds.

name: Ophelia's Pact
description: Grants stats and summons a minion to assist in battle.
flavor: A holy pact signed in the presence of Ophelia, binding forest creatures to your command.

name: Pegasus Boots
description: Grants high movement speed and active phase walk through units.
flavor: Enchanted with winged feathers that allow the bearer to glide unhindered through enemy ranks.

name: Madfred's Brass Knuckles
description: Grants attack speed, lifesteal, and bonus physical damage against creeps.
flavor: Brutal iron knuckles forged by the street brawler Madfred to overwhelm opponents in close quarters.

name: Genjuro
description: Activate to turn invisible, gaining +20% movement speed and dealing 225 bonus damage on break attack while slowing target.
flavor: A phantom blade forged by shadow assassins that shrouds its wielder in darkness before delivering a lethal strike.
upgrade: Advanced stealth & break attack sword.

name: Riftshards
description: Grants +45 Attack Damage and a 20% chance to deal 1.6x critical strike damage on Level 1.
flavor: Crystal shards shattered from dimensional rifts that tear through physical armor to inflict catastrophic wounds.
upgrade: Upgradable up to Level 4 for +925 Gold per recipe scroll (+0.2x critical multiplier per tier).

name: Thunderclaw
description: Grants +24 Attack Damage, +25 Attack Speed, and a chance on attack to release bouncing chain lightning.
flavor: Electrified claws imbued with storm energy that shock groups of enemies.

name: Frostwolf's Skull
description: Attacks slow enemy movement speed by 30% and attack speed by 20% for 3 seconds.
flavor: Enchanted with the eternal frost of the Northern Wastes, this skull encases enemy targets in crippling ice.

name: Wingbow
description: Grants +30 Agility, +30 Attack Damage, +30 Attack Speed, and +35% Evasion against physical attacks.
flavor: Crafted from light-elemental wood and feathers of the Great Falcon, granting unmatched agility and evasion in combat.
upgrade: Ultimate agility & evasion artifact.

name: Mock of Brilliance
description: Passively deals 45 Magic Damage per second to all nearby enemies in a 700 radius.
flavor: An ancient radiant blade radiating blinding flames that scorch surrounding foes continuously.

name: Doom Bringer
description: Grants +250 Attack Damage. Drops on ground upon hero death.
flavor: A cursed greatsword of apocalyptic power. Its devastating edge turns the tide of war, but loss of the blade brings ruin.
upgrade: Drops on ground upon hero death!

name: Symbol of Rage
description: Grants +25 Strength, +30 Damage, +5 Armor, +25% Lifesteal. Activate to gain +150% Lifesteal for 5 seconds.
flavor: Imbued with primal fury, this demonic emblem allows warriors to convert inflicted wounds into instant physical rejuvenation.

name: Codex
description: Activate to strike target enemy hero for 400 Magic Damage on Level 1.
flavor: A tome of destructive incantations capable of unleashing devastating lightning bolts at short range.
upgrade: Upgradable up to Level 5 for +1,000 Gold per recipe scroll (+100 Magic Damage per tier).

name: Shieldbreaker
description: Attacks reduce target enemy armor by up to 6 for 5 seconds.
flavor: A serrated warhammer designed to shatter enemy armor plates with every blow.
upgrade: Reduces target physical armor on basic attacks.

name: Savage Mace
description: Grants +80 Damage, +15 Attack Speed, and true strike chance dealing bonus mini-stun damage.
flavor: A heavy spiked flail that bypasses evasion to crush enemy defenses with relentless force.

name: Ring of Sorcery
description: Activate to restore 135 Mana to all nearby allied heroes. A.K.A. Mana Ring.
flavor: A glowing band of arcane sapphire that releases pulses of mana to sustain allied spellcasters.

name: Helm of the Black Legion
description: Grants +300 Health, +6 Health Regen, and a chance to block 40 physical damage from attacks.
flavor: Forged for the elite shock troopers of the Black Legion, providing formidable health and damage deflection.

name: Runed Cleaver
description: Grants +55 Damage, +6 Health Regen, +150% Mana Regen, and melee attacks cleave for 60% damage.
flavor: Engraved with cleaving runes that spread physical strikes to slash through adjacent enemies.

name: Assassin's Shroud
description: Activate to turn invisible for 12 seconds, gaining 20% movement speed and dealing +125 bonus damage on break attack.
flavor: A dark cloak woven from shadow silk that conceals assassins from sight until they strike.
upgrade: Can be upgraded into Genjuro.

name: Puzzlebox
description: Summons two Puzzlebox minions to fight by your side for 35 seconds.
flavor: A mechanical artifact housing ancient fiends ready to serve whoever unravels its lock.
upgrade: Upgradable up to Level 3 for +700 Gold per recipe scroll.

name: Barbed Armor
description: Activate to reflect 100% of incoming damage back to attacking enemy heroes for 4.5 seconds.
flavor: Spiked armor plating that punishes attackers by reflecting the violence back upon them.

name: Dawnbringer
description: Grants +25 All Attributes, +30 Attack Speed, +300 Health, +300 Mana. Attacks slow move/attack speed, apply fire damage over time, and grant bonus movement speed.
flavor: Forged at the collision of celestial solar energy and ancient elemental steel, Dawnbringer radiates a blinding light that incinerates darkness and empowers its bearer to lead the charge into victory.
upgrade: Ultimate tri-sword combining Lightbrand, Frostbrand, and Firebrand.

name: Staff of the Master
description: Grants +10 All Attributes, +200 Health, +150 Mana, and enhances hero ultimate abilities.
flavor: The legendary relic of high archmages, unlocking latent god-like power in hero ultimate spells.
upgrade: Unlocks empowered effects for hero ultimate abilities.

name: Alchemist's Bones
description: Grants +30 Attack Speed. Activate to transmute a non-hero creep into gold.
flavor: Enchanted bones that turn enemy blood into pure gold.

name: Icon of the Goddess
description: Grants +450 Health, +400 Mana, +4 Health Regen, +150% Mana Regen. Gains charges on hero kills.
flavor: A sacred effigy of the goddess of life that grows in power with every enemy defeat.

name: Shaman's Headdress
description: Grants +30% Magic Resistance and +8 Health Regeneration.
flavor: Woven with spirit feathers by tribal shamans to ward off hostile sorcery.
upgrade: Can be upgraded into Barrier Idol.

name: Ring of the Teacher
description: Grants +6 Damage and an aura providing +2 Armor and +0.65 Mana Regen.
flavor: A simple silver ring worn by scholars that radiates a aura of focus to surrounding allies.
upgrade: Can be upgraded into Abyssal Skull, Lex Talionis, or Nome's Wisdom.

name: Steamstaff
description: Grants +10 Attack Speed and +6 Damage.
flavor: A pressurized staff that releases steam bursts on attack.
upgrade: Builds into Assassin's Shroud, Insanitarius, or Arcana.

name: Bottle (3/3)
description: A simple empty bottle that can be filled with healing water or magical runes.
flavor: Absorbs power from runes to restore health and mana over time.

name: Minor Totem
description: A simple wooden totem carved by primitive tribes. Grants +1 to all attributes.
flavor: A small wooden token offering subtle ancestral protection.

name: Mark of the Novice
description: Grants +3 Intelligence. Acolyte charm expanding magical aptitude.
flavor: A small talisman pulsing with faint arcane potential.

name: Duck Boots
description: Grants +3 Agility. Lightweight boots favored by nimble heroes.
flavor: Sturdy leather footwear designed for agile scouts.

name: Crushing Claws
description: Grants +3 Strength. Iron gauntlets boosting physical power.
flavor: Heavy gauntlets that reinforce blows with brute strength.

name: Pretender's Crown
description: Grants +2 Strength, +2 Agility, and +2 Intelligence. Minor crown boosting all attributes.
flavor: A modest circlet granting general vigor.

name: Perpetual Cogwheel
description: Grants +12 Intelligence and +15% Mana Regeneration. Precision gearwork catalyst.
flavor: A fine brass gear turning ceaselessly with kinetic force.

name: Sol's Bulwark
description: Can be toggled between a positive Armor aura (+6 Armor) for allies and a negative Armor aura for enemies.
flavor: A massive shield forged in Sol's sacred fires, radiating protective radiance to allies and burning nearby foes.

name: Warpcleft
description: Grants +55 Attack Speed. Heavy gloves engineered for rapid combat execution.
flavor: An ancient relic of Newerth forged to empower heroes in the war against the Hellbourne.

name: Platemail
description: Grants +10 Armor. Heavy plate armor providing immense physical resistance.
flavor: Thick plates of tempered steel forged in the blacksmiths of Legion, offering unyielding defense against heavy physical blows.

name: Broadsword
description: Grants +18 Damage. Sharp steel blade used in high-tier physical recipes.
flavor: A standard double-edged blade favored by frontline warriors for its balance and deadly cutting edge.

name: Pickled Brain
description: Grants +150 Mana. Preserved relic expanding the wielder's spell reserves.
flavor: A preserved alchemical specimen that stimulates mental acuity and increases magical potency at a grisly cost.

name: Glowstone
description: Grants +200 Health and +150 Mana. Radiant gem providing health and mana pool extension.
flavor: Pulsates with ambient energy harvested from natural mana ley lines.

name: Neophyte's Book
description: Grants +10 Intelligence and +6 Damage. Standard study tome for novice mages.
flavor: Filled with fundamental incantations of elemental energy.

name: Halberd
description: Grants +10 Strength and +10 Damage. Heavy polearm providing balance and hit power.
flavor: A versatile polearm combining spear and axe, designed to keep enemy vanguards at bay.

name: Slayer
description: Grants +46 Damage. Sharp battle blade used in high-tier physical weapon recipes.
flavor: A wicked zweihander that thirsts for blood in melee combat.

name: Dancing Blade
description: Grants +30 Agility. Mastercrafted rapier granting intense precision and attack speed.
flavor: Lightweight and perfectly balanced, humming with graceful lethal grace.

name: Sword of the High
description: Grants +64 Damage. Legendary blade of supreme physical devastation.
flavor: An ancient relic wielded by high champions of the legion.

name: Trinket of Restoration
description: Grants +2 Health Regeneration. Enchanted pendant restoring health over time.
flavor: A delicate charm blessed by priestesses of Nymphora, continuously mending minor wounds during battle.

name: Mystic Vestments
description: Grants +5 Magic Armor. Protective robes mitigating incoming spell damage.
flavor: Robes woven with anti-magic thread, insulating the wearer against destructive elemental incantations.

name: Icebrand
description: Grants +16 Strength and +10 Damage. Basic attacks apply a 20% movement speed slow for 2.5 seconds.
flavor: A frosted blade forged from glacial ore that chills targets upon impact.

name: Firebrand
description: Grants +10 Agility, +15 Movement Speed, and +10% Attack Speed. Basic attacks gain +5% movement speed on hit.
flavor: A blazing saber imbued with solar heat that accelerates combat movement.

name: Lightbrand
description: Grants +10 Intelligence, +15 Movement Speed, and +15% Mana Regeneration. Basic attacks inflict Searing Light, dealing magic damage over time.
flavor: A blade of condensed solar energy that singes enemies upon contact.

name: Gloves of the Swift
description: Grants +15 Attack Speed. Leather gauntlets accelerating attack tempo.
flavor: Light leather gauntlets crafted to accelerate weapon attacks.

name: Marchers
description: Essential battle component: Marchers.
flavor: Sturdy leather boots crafted for long journeys across the treacherous battlefields of Newerth.

name: Mighty Blade
description: Grants +10 Strength. Sturdy broadsword providing raw health and durability.
flavor: Heavy iron sword forged for front-line warriors.

name: Refreshing Ornament
description: Grants +2 Health Regeneration and +1.0 Mana Regeneration. Medallion restoring vitality.
flavor: Emits a soothing warm aura that heals wounds over time.

name: Evasion Charm
description: Grants +25% Evasion. Magical talisman causing physical attacks to miss.
flavor: Distorts space around the wielder to slip past incoming blows.

name: Luminous Prism
description: Grants +200 Health and +200 Mana. Crystal lens storing vital essence.
flavor: Reflects light into pure protective mana and life force.

name: Agility Staff
description: Grants +35 Agility and +10 Attack Speed. Mastercraft staff for agile heroes.
flavor: Whirls through the air with fluid, graceful momentum.

name: Bolstering Armband
description: Grants +6 Strength. Reinforced armband boosting physical vital power.
flavor: A sacred band woven with blessed runes that fortifies the bearer's physical strength.

name: Major Totem
description: Essential battle component: Major Totem.
flavor: A heavy wooden totem carved with ancient tribal runes, imbuing the bearer with raw physical and magical attributes.

name: Hungry Spirit
description: Grants +15% Lifesteal and +10 Damage. Vampiric talisman absorbing life from basic attacks.
flavor: A dark spirit trapped in silver, hungering for enemy life force.

name: Acolyte's Staff
description: Grants +25 Intelligence. High-tier magical catalyst for spellcasters.
flavor: Carved from elderwood and topped with a glowing sapphire focus.

name: Warhammer
description: Grants +24 Damage. Heavy crushing weapon favored by physical brawlers.
flavor: A heavy warhammer forged from enchanted steel, heavy enough to shatter bone and shield alike.

name: Iron Buckler
description: Essential battle component: Iron Buckler.
flavor: A compact iron shield engineered to deflect light melee attacks and projectile skirmishes.

name: Scarab
description: Essential battle component: Scarab.
flavor: A jeweled scarab relic that converts spiritual focus into a shield against magical damage.

name: Mana Battery
description: Essential battle component: Mana Battery.
flavor: A crystal capacitor that absorbs nearby spell energy, discharging it to replenish vital mana.

name: Beastheart
description: Essential battle component: Beastheart.
flavor: The preserved heart of a primordial beast, pulsing with primitive vitality to grant immense health.

name: Lifetube
description: Essential battle component: Lifetube.
flavor: A brass cylinder housing life-sustaining nectar that rapidly accelerates natural wound recovery.

name: Guardian Ring
description: Essential battle component: Guardian Ring.
flavor: An ancient relic of Newerth forged to empower heroes in the war against the Hellbourne.

name: Blessed Orb
description: Grants +10 Strength, +10 Agility, +10 Intelligence, +250 Health, and +250 Mana.
flavor: A pristine orb radiating Sol's ultimate blessing.

name: Geometer's Bane
description: Grants +15 Strength, +15 Agility, +15 Attack Speed, and +10 Movement Speed. Activate to split into 3 illusions for 20 seconds, removing negative debuffs.
flavor: An ancient obsidian prism that refracts the wielder into multiple lethal phantasms.
upgrade: Splits wielder into 3 illusions and cleanses debuffs on activation.

name: Spiked Bola
description: Activate to launch a weighted bola at target enemy hero, entangling them for 2.5 seconds and reducing their movement speed by 35%.
flavor: Heavy spiked iron balls chained together, designed to wrap around enemy legs in mid-sprint.
upgrade: Active entangle & slow for chasing high-speed targets.

name: Nullfire Blade
description: Grants +25 Agility, +10 Attack Speed. Basic attacks burn 20 Mana per hit. Activate to purge target.
flavor: Enchanted twin blades that burn enemy spell reserves on contact.
upgrade: Burns mana on attack and purges buffs/debuffs on activation. Upgradable up to Level 3 for +860 Gold per recipe scroll.

name: Wind Whistle
description: Grants +5 Movement Speed.
flavor: A lightweight silver whistle.

name: Quickblade
description: Grants +10 Agility.
flavor: A slender steel blade crafted for rapid striking.

name: Soulscream Ring
description: Grants +3 Strength, +3 Agility, +3 Intelligence, and +3 Damage.
flavor: A silver ring whispering soul melodies.

name: Energizer
description: Grants +6 Strength, +6 Agility, +6 Intelligence, +75 Mana, +1.0 Mana Regeneration, and +5 Movement Speed. Activate to grant nearby allies +15% Movement Speed for 5 seconds.
flavor: An ornate brass cylinder pulsing with kinetic energy, boosting allied movement speed in combat.
upgrade: Active group speed boost for team initiation and disengage.

name: Apprentice's Robe
description: Grants +6 Intelligence.
flavor: Simple robes worn by novice spellcasters to focus their mental concentration.

name: Punchdagger
description: Grants +9 Damage.
flavor: Lightweight thrusting blade.

name: Helm of the Victim
description: Grants +5 Armor and +5 Health Regeneration.
flavor: Ancient sacrificial helm.

name: Insanitarius
description: Activate to gain +31 Attack Damage, +25 Attack Speed, and +25 Strength, but drains 25 Health per second while active.
flavor: A cursed tribal mask that grants immense dark power at the cost of the wielder's vitality.
upgrade: Active strength and damage surge at health drain cost.

name: Soultrap
description: Grants +200 Health, +200 Mana, +5 Health Regeneration. Basic attacks trap enemy souls, stealing life and movement speed.
flavor: An ethereal crown that entraps the souls of slain warriors.
upgrade: Traps enemy souls on basic attacks.

name: Ghost Marchers
description: Grants +70 Movement Speed, +24 Damage. Activate to gain unit collision pass-through and +12% movement speed.
flavor: Enchanted boots allowing the wearer to phase through physical obstacles like a ghost.
upgrade: Active phased movement through units.

name: Hypercrown
description: Grants +30 All Attributes and +30 Attack Speed. Mastercraft crown of primordial elemental energy.
flavor: The crown of hyperia, burning with eternal stellar fire.
upgrade: Ultimate attribute and attack speed crown.

name: Elder Parasite
description: Grants +15% Lifesteal, +15 Attack Speed. Activate to gain +100 Attack Speed and +15% Movement Speed, but increases damage taken by 15% for 12 seconds.
flavor: A grotesque parasite that feeds on the host's blood to unleash insane battle frenzy.
upgrade: Surge attack speed and movement speed at cost of increased damage taken.

name: Iron Shield
description: Grants +3 Strength, +3 Agility, +3 Intelligence, and 100% chance to block 20 damage from hero attacks.
flavor: Reinforced iron buckler providing guaranteed physical damage block.
upgrade: Guaranteed physical attack damage block.

name: Behemoth's Heart
description: Grants +35 Strength, +350 Max Health. Passively regenerates 1% of Max Health per second when out of combat.
flavor: The pulsating heart of an ancient behemoth, granting immense vitality and rapid health regeneration.
upgrade: Passively regenerates max health out of combat.

name: Alacrity Band
description: +30% Attack Speed
flavor: Authentic Heroes of Newerth Alacrityband.

name: Axe of the Malphai
description: Grants +25 Strength.
flavor: A heavy battleaxe forged by the legendary Malphai clan.

name: Blood Ruby
description: Grants +150 Max Health.
flavor: A crimson gemstone pulsing with vital health essence.

name: Bound Eye
description: Grants True Sight to reveal invisible units and wards within a 900 radius around the hero. Drops on ground upon death.
flavor: An eerie preserved eye that pierces the veil of stealth, forcing unseen shadows into the light.

name: Kongor's Bananas
description: Can only be obtained by slaying KONGOR. Instantly restores 2,500 Health and 1,500 Mana upon consumption.
flavor: Kongor's prized celestial bananas, providing miraculous instant healing when consumed.

name: Confluence
description: +10 Strength, +10 Agility, +10 Intelligence
flavor: Authentic Heroes of Newerth Confluence.

name: Dust of Revelation
description: Reveals invisible units and wards in a 1,050 radius for 12 seconds and slows revealed enemy units by 15%.
flavor: Finely ground luminous dust that clings to invisible foes, revealing their hidden outlines.

name: Tome of Elements
description: Unlocks elemental essences to grant bonus spell power and attribute masteries.
flavor: An ancient grimoire detailing elemental control over fire, frost, and lightning.

name: Ether Jewel
description: +100 Max Mana
flavor: Authentic Heroes of Newerth Etherjewel.

name: Fleetfeet
description: +6 Agility
flavor: Authentic Heroes of Newerth Fleetfeet.

name: Fortuna's Dice
description: Grants a random chance on physical attack to trigger bonus gold earned or critical strike damage.
flavor: Gambler's dice blessed by Fortuna, where every roll of the die determines fortune or ruin on the battlefield.

name: Health Potion
description: Restores 400 Health over 10 seconds. Dispelled if damage is taken from an enemy hero or structure.
flavor: A staple elixir brewed from healing herbs, providing essential recovery for wounded soldiers.

name: Homecoming Stone
description: Teleports the hero to a target friendly structure after channeling for 3 seconds.
flavor: A rune-inscribed stone linked to kingdom fortresses, allowing instantaneous tactical retreats.

name: Ioyn Stone
description: +60 Max Health, +45 Max Mana
flavor: Authentic Heroes of Newerth Ioynstone.

name: Lunar Tear
description: +0.5 Health Regen
flavor: Authentic Heroes of Newerth Lunartear.

name: Manatube
description: Grants +2.5 Mana Regen.
flavor: A delicate glass vial containing pure mana stream essence.

name: Ward of Revelation
description: Consumable that grants True Sight in a target area for 10 seconds.
flavor: A magical eye relic that reveals hidden invisible forces in the targeted area.

name: Nihil Crystal
description: Passively reduces nearby enemies' Magic Armor by 3 and grants +250 Max Mana.
flavor: A dark obsidian crystal that radiates an aura of magical decay.

name: Rejuvenation Potion
description: Restores 100 Health and 100 Mana instantly to the hero.
flavor: A concentrated potion that restores both mind and body in a single draught.

name: Ringmail
description: Grants +4 Armor.
flavor: Authentic Heroes of Newerth Ringmail.

name: Snake Bracelet
description: Grants +6 Agility, +3 Strength, and +3 Intelligence.
flavor: A serpent-shaped bracelet worn by assassin guilds of Sang-La.

name: Spyglass
description: Reveals target fogged area for 10 seconds and grants True Sight in the targeted region.
flavor: A brass telescope enchanted to see through optical illusions and dense fog.

name: Token of Stealth
description: Places an invisible Ward of Revelation that grants True Sight in an 800 radius for 6 minutes.
flavor: A specialized ward tuned to sense ethereal distortions and hidden assassins.

name: Token of Life
description: Can only be obtained by slaying KONGOR. Instantly revives the hero at base with full Health and Mana upon death.
flavor: A legendary artifact dropped by Kongor, granting miraculous resurrection to the warrior who claims it.

name: Toxin Claws
description: Physical attacks apply a poison that slows enemy movement speed by 12% and deals 12 Magic Damage per second for 3 seconds.
flavor: Vicious gauntlets tipped with wyvern venom that seep into enemy wounds.

name: Voltstone
description: Grants +100 Max Mana and +1.5 Mana Regen.
flavor: A crackling orb of static energy harvested from thunder peaks.

name: Adeve's Cloak
description: +240 Max Health, +160 Max Mana
flavor: Authentic Heroes of Newerth Adevescloak.

name: Sorcery Boots
description: +3 Strength, +3 Agility, +6 Intelligence, +250 Max Mana
flavor: Authentic Heroes of Newerth Arcaneboots.

name: Armor of the Mad Mage
description: +20 Intelligence, +8 Armor, +8 Health Regen
flavor: Authentic Heroes of Newerth Armorofthemadmage.

name: Bloodborne Maul
description: +35 Strength
flavor: Authentic Heroes of Newerth Bloodbornemaul.

name: Brutalizer
description: +12 Strength, +40 Damage
flavor: Authentic Heroes of Newerth Brutalizer.

name: Charged Hammer
description: +90% Attack Speed
flavor: Authentic Heroes of Newerth Lightning2.

name: Corrupted Sword
description: +70 Damage
flavor: Authentic Heroes of Newerth Corruptedsword.

name: Faux Bow
description: +30% Attack Speed, +6 Agility, +4 Damage
flavor: Authentic Heroes of Newerth Fauxbow.

name: Critical2
description: Grants +30 Damage and a 20% chance to land a 2.0x Critical Strike.
flavor: Authentic Heroes of Newerth Critical2.

name: Flying Courier
description: Summons a winged flying courier to deliver items swiftly across the map.
flavor: A trained winged companion delivering items swiftly from base.

name: Frostfield Plate
description: +3 Strength, +3 Agility, +35 Intelligence, +14 Armor
flavor: Authentic Heroes of Newerth Frostfieldplate.

name: Frozen Light
description: Grants +10 Damage, +16 Strength, +16 Intelligence, +2.5 Mana Regen, and spell damage bonus.
flavor: Combination of Icebrand and Lightbrand, channelling frost and light energy.

name: Arcana
description: Grants +12 Damage, +6 Intelligence, +10% Attack Speed, and +50% Mana Regeneration.
flavor: A sacred scepter of ancient archmages that channels chaotic spell power into focused physical force.

name: Frostburn
description: Grants +10 Damage, +16 Strength, +16 Agility, +20% Attack Speed, and applies movement slow on hit.
flavor: The twin elemental blades Icebrand and Firebrand merged into a lethal weapon.

name: Fortified Bracer
description: +6 Strength, +3 Agility, +3 Intelligence
flavor: Authentic Heroes of Newerth Strength5.

name: Post Haste
description: Grants +100 Movement Speed and teleportation to friendly units.
flavor: Enchanted boots infused with wind runes for instant battlefield traversal.

name: Searing Light
description: Grants +16 Agility, +16 Intelligence, +20% Attack Speed, +2.5 Mana Regen.
flavor: Combination of Firebrand and Lightbrand, radiating searing heat and arcana.

name: Shield of the Five
description: Grants +4 Armor, +2 Strength, +2 Agility, +2 Intelligence.
flavor: A fortified buckler blessed to protect allied ranks.

name: Spell Sunder
description: Grants +200 Max Health, +200 Max Mana, and spell armor penetration.
flavor: A jagged ritual blade that sunders magical defenses.

name: Amulet of Exile
description: Grants +3 Strength, +3 Agility, and +6 Intelligence.
flavor: An ancient talisman carved from banished spirits, channeling arcane energy into the wearer.

name: Twin Blades
description: Grants +10% Attack Speed, +10 Intelligence, and +30 Damage.
flavor: Dual enchanted blades striking in flawless harmony.

name: Ultor's Heavy Helm
description: Grants +15 Armor, +10 Strength, and an aura that reduces enemy attack speeds by 20%.
flavor: Formidable heavy plate worn by the warlord Ultor.

name: Whispering Helm
description: Grants +5 Armor, +3 Health Regeneration, and lifesteal.
flavor: A dark skeletal visor echoing ancestral battle cries.

name: Ground Courier
description: Summons a ground courier to deliver items from base.
flavor: A stout ground companion trained to transport equipment.

name: Stormspirit
description: When activated, traps target hero in a Cyclone for 2.5 seconds. Upon landing the target will be Windswept for 1 second. Grants +10 Intelligence, +125% Mana Regeneration, and +25 Movement Speed.
flavor: Ever since the War of the Ancients, wild Stormspirits have scourged the surface of Newerth. With the right rituals and words of binding, a Stormspirit can be bound as a familiar, bestowing enhanced magical powers, the spirit's own speed, and the ability to call forth the winds against one's foes.
